resources.string: Manage connected devices and approve access for each terminal session.
Device and approval status will appear when the runtime service connects.
Direct USB connections require an Android device with USB Host support. Mounted storage folders can still be shared below.
Connect a device with a data-capable cable or USB OTG adapter. Unlock the connected device if needed.
Run a terminal-usb command to request access. Requests expire after two minutes. Approve here, then rerun the command.
Android USB permission and this app’s session approval are separate. Only approved sessions can access devices.
Enter account information or verification codes requested by a trusted tool. Secrets stay out of the terminal.
All USB device and storage-folder approvals for this session will be revoked. Active USB work in the session will be canceled. The terminal session and other sessions will keep running.
Remove this folder from the app and revoke related session access. Active transfers to this folder will stop. Files already on the storage device will not be deleted.
Could not connect to the USB service. Reopen this screen to reconnect.
The USB action could not be completed. Check the connection and try again.
This request has expired. Rerun the terminal command to request access again.
The USB device was disconnected. Reconnect it, list devices and request access again.
The folder is unavailable or does not allow this access. Reconnect the storage device or choose the folder again.
This device is already in use. Finish the active operation or revoke its session access before retrying.
Android USB permission is required. Approve the permission prompt or request access again.
